meta.title: Order Activity is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid
gaps: The prepared state provides a live RFQ with one bid, so the specific precondition that both Vendor An and Vendor B have bid cannot be verified.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state provides a live RFQ with one bid, so the specific precondition that both Vendor An and Vendor B have bid cannot be verified.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's event summary page.
Assert that Order Activity is present and clickable in the event Settings menu.
Select Order Activity to open its activity drawer.
Assert that the Activity window opened.
Cancel the Activity window as specified, without confirming any changes.
Assert that the Activity window closed after cancellation.
